📦 MyntraFlash Microservice
• 🎨 Frontend: Store UI + Hostname Badge
• ⚡ Catalog API: GET /products
• 🏷️ Pricing Engine: GET /api/discount (CPU Hash)
• 🎯 AI Mock: GET /api/recommend
• 💚 Vitality: GET /health (sub-5ms)
• 💾 In-Memory Store: Zero DB Cost ($0.00)

div.style: color: rgb(88, 28, 135) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
🧠 Cloud Autoscaler & Monitoring
• Tracks Fleet Average CPU %
• Scale-Out: CPU > 70% ➔ +1 Server
• Scale-In: CPU < 30% ➔ -1 Server
• Anti-Flapping: 5 min cool-down window
